what_works: Sage-green and cream agricultural palette with illustrated diagrams replacing stock photography — every section walks through 'how it works on your soil' rather than 'about us.' A landscaper or lawn-treatment crew can lift the diagrammed-process structure verbatim and feel like a specialist, not a generalist.
what_does_not_translate: The plant-growth scroll animations and corn-crop preloader are bespoke illustration work — the contractor build replaces those with three simple SVG icons in the same palette.
type_observations: Single grotesk in two weights (medium display ~64px, regular body 16px); no decorative serif, the diagrams carry the personality.
